Which of the following interchange of mathematical signs would make the given equation correct?

20 ÷ 4 × 8 + 16 - 15 = 11
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Here, interchange the mathematical signs to make the equation correct.

Given:- 20 ÷ 4 × 8 + 16 - 15 = 11

Option 1) -, ÷

After interchanging the sign we get the:

⇒ 20 - 4 × 8 + 16 ÷ 15 = 11

⇒ 20 - 4 × 8 + 1.066 = 11

⇒ 20 - 32 + 1.066 = 11

⇒ 21.066 - 32 = 11

⇒ - 10.934 ≠ 11

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) +, -

After interchanging the sign we get the:

⇒ 20 ÷ 4 × 8 - 16 + 15 = 11

⇒ 5 × 8 - 16 + 15 = 11

⇒ 40 - 16 + 15 = 11

⇒ 55 - 16 = 11

⇒ 39 ≠ 11

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) ×, ÷

After interchanging the sign we get the:

⇒ 20 × 4 ÷ 8 + 16 - 15 = 11

⇒ 20 × 0.5 + 16 -15 = 11

⇒ 10 + 16 - 15 = 11

⇒ 26 - 15 = 11

⇒ 11 = 11

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 4) +, ×

After interchanging the sign we get the:

⇒ 20 ÷ 4 + 8 × 16 - 15 = 11

⇒ 5 + 8 × 16 - 15 = 11

⇒ 5 + 128 - 15 = 11

⇒ 133 - 15 = 11

⇒ 118 ≠ 11

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.q: Wangala festival is celebrated by which of the following tribes?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Garo tribe.

Key Points

• Known as the '100 Drum Festival', the Wangala Festival is a traditional festival in the northeastern Indian state of Meghalaya.

• The festival kicked off on November 12th, 2021.

• The festival lasts from two days to a week.

• It is one of the most important festivals of the Garo Tribe.

• The tribesmen make sacrifices to please their god Saljong.

Important Points

• The Wangala festival marks the end of a period of toil, that brings good results to the fields which also signifies the onset of winter.

• It is also celebrated in honour of the Sun God that marks the end of the long harvest season.

• Wangala is celebrated with different forms of dance.

• These dances are performed on the tunes of folk songs that are played on drums and primitive flute.

• Additionally, these flutes are made of buffalo horns.

• On the first day of the festival, people celebrate it with a ceremony called Ragula.

• This ceremony is performed in the house of the village’s chief.

• Then on the second day of celebration, which is called Kakkat, people begin the ceremony by dancing to the rhythms of long oval-shaped drums.

• In this celebration, young and old join together while men play the drums and women perform traditional dance forms. The dance form is known as Dama Dagota.

questions.q: Which Article deals with the 'Power of Parliament to amend the Constitution and procedure therefor'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Article 368.

Key Points Article 368

• ​Power of Parliament to amend the Constitution and procedure therefor.

• Parliament may in the exercise of its constituent power amend by way of addition, variation or repeal any provision of this Constitution in accordance with the procedure laid down in this article.

• An amendment of this Constitution may be initiated only by the introduction of a Bill for the purpose in either House of Parliament.

• When the Bill is passed in each House by a majority of the total membership of that House and by a majority of not less than two-thirds of the members of that House present and voting, it shall be presented to the President.

Additional Information

Article 352

• Article 352(National Emergency) says that if the president is satisfied that a grave emergency exists whereby the security of India or any part of the territory of India is threatened by war or external aggression or armed rebellion, he may proclaim an emergency.

• This emergency may be with respect to the whole or part of India.

Article 356

• Under Article 356 of the Constitution of India, if a state government is unable to function according to Constitutional provisions, the Union government can take direct control of the state machinery

• Article;356 states that “If the President, on receipt of a report from the Governor of the State or otherwise, is satisfied that a situation has arisen in which the government of the State cannot be carried on in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution, the President may be Proclaim emergency in a state”.

Article 249

• Article 249 of the Indian constitution is related to the Legislative Powers of parliament with respect to subjects in the state list. It empowers the Parliament to make laws with respect to any matter enumerated in the state list.

• ​The balance sheet is a financial statement that lists a company's assets, liabilities, equity capital, total debt, and other items as of a particular point in time.

• Liabilities are listed on the opposite side of the balance sheet from assets.

• One of the three primary financial statements used to assess a company is the balance sheet.

• It offers a summary of a company's financial situation as of the publication date.

• The assets on the balance sheet are equal to the total of the liabilities plus the shareholders' equity.

• Financial ratios are computed using balance sheets by fundamental analysts.

questions.q:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The indentured labourers fix the roads.
options: The roads was fixed by indentured labourers.
The roads were fixed by indentured labourers.
The roads are fixed by indentured labourers.
The roads were being fixed by indentured labourers.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'The roads are fixed by indentured labourers.'

Key Points

• The given sentence is in the active voice. We have to change the sentence into passive form.

• The given sentence is written in 'simple present tense.'

• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:

• Active Voice: Subject + V1 + Object.

• Passive Voice: Object + am/is/are + V3 + by (preposition) + Subject.

• Let’s see another example:

• Active voice: She plays cricket.

• Passive voice: Cricket is played by her.

• The subject of the given sentence is 'The indentured labourers' and the object of the given sentence is 'the roads'.

• So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged.

• Also here, 'fix' will be changed into 'are fixed'.

Correct Sentence: *The roads are fixed by indentured labourers.*
